basic_info.description: Top floor, updated home a half block from Dolores Park and in the heart of Mission Dolores! Renovated for modern living, this classic San Francisco flat has an updated, eat-in kitchen and retains its original charm with many period details including bay windows. In-unit laundry and a modern hall bath with walk-in shower make this 2 bedroom home perfect for today's lifestyle and move-in ready. Assigned storage space is included, along with space for bikes. Seismically retrofitted to meet modern requirements. Make this tremendous Mission Dolores location yours and enjoy some of San Francisco's best cafes, restaurants, and shopping along 18th Street and the Valencia Corridor. Walk Score 98! Photos of similar unit, finishes and layout may vary.
